  <option integrator="implicitfast" cone="elliptic" impratio="10"/>
  <default>
    <default class="ur5e">
      <material specular="0.5" shininess="0.25"/>
      <joint axis="0 1 0" range="-6.28319 6.28319" armature="0.1"/>
      <general gaintype="fixed" biastype="affine" ctrlrange="-6.2831 6.2831" gainprm="2000" biasprm="0 -2000 -400" forcerange="-150 150"/>
      <default class="size3">
        <default class="size3_limited">
          <joint range="-3.1415 3.1415"/>
          <general ctrlrange="-3.1415 3.1415"/>
        </default>
      </default>

      </default>
      <default class="visual">
        <geom type="mesh" contype="0" conaffinity="0" group="2"/>
      </default>
      <default class="collision">
        <geom type="capsule" group="3"/>
        <default class="eef_collision">
          <geom type="cylinder"/>
        </default>
      </default>
      <site size="0.001" rgba="0.5 0.5 0.5 0.3" group="4"/>
    </default>
    <default class="2f85">
      <mesh scale="0.001 0.001 0.001"/>
      <general biastype="affine"/>
      <joint axis="1 0 0"/>
      <default class="driver">
        <joint range="0 0.8" armature="0.005" damping="0.1" solimplimit="0.95 0.99 0.001" solreflimit="0.005 1"/>
      </default>
      <default class="follower">
        <joint range="-0.872664 0.872664" armature="0.001" pos="0 -0.018 0.0065" solimplimit="0.95 0.99 0.001" solreflimit="0.005 1"/>
      </default>
      <default class="spring_link">
        <joint range="-0.29670597283 0.8" armature="0.001" stiffness="0.05" springref="2.62" damping="0.00125"/>
      </default>
      <default class="coupler">
        <joint range="-1.57 0" armature="0.001" solimplimit="0.95 0.99 0.001" solreflimit="0.005 1"/>
      </default>
    </default>
  </default>
</mujoco>"""

root_defaults = ET.fromstring(xml_str)

# Build a flat map: class_name -> {joint: {...}, general: {...}}
class_map = {}

def parse_defaults(node, parent_class=None):
    cls = node.get("class", parent_class)
    entry = class_map.setdefault(cls, {})
    for child in node:
        if child.tag in ("joint", "general", "geom", "site", "mesh"):
            entry[child.tag] = dict(child.attrib)
        elif child.tag == "default":
            parse_defaults(child, cls)

for d in root_defaults.iter("default"):
    parse_defaults(d)

for k, v in class_map.items():
    print(f"  [{k}]")
    for tag, attrs in v.items():
        print(f"    {tag}: {attrs}")

# Now parse joints and actuators from the full XML (embedded as string)

                  <joint name="wrist_3_joint" class="size1"/>
                  <site name="attachment_site" pos="0 0.1 0" quat="-1 1 0 0"/>
                  <body name="robotiq_mount" pos="0 0.1 0" quat="-1 1 0 0" childclass="2f85">
                    <body name="base_mount" pos="0 0 0.007" childclass="2f85">
                      <body name="robotiq_base" pos="0 0 0.0038" quat="1 0 0 -1">
                        <site name="pinch" pos="0 0 0.145" type="sphere" group="5" rgba="0.9 0.9 0.9 1" size="0.005"/>
                        <site name="pinch_site" pos="0 0 0.145" type="sphere" group="5" rgba="0.9 0.9 0.9 1" size="0.005"/>
                        <body name="right_driver" pos="0 0.0306011 0.054904">

root2 = ET.fromstring(full_xml)

# ── Resolve ctrlrange for a joint given its class ──────────────────────────
# Inheritance chain for ur5e joints:
#   size3         -> inherits ur5e general ctrlrange="-6.2831 6.2831"

#   size1         -> inherits ur5e general ctrlrange="-6.2831 6.2831"

joint_class_ctrlrange = {

    "size1":         [-6.2831, 6.2831],
    "driver":        [0.0, 0.8],
    "follower":      [-0.872664, 0.872664],
    "spring_link":   [-0.29670597283, 0.8],
    "coupler":       [-1.57, 0.0],
}

    "size3":         [0, 1, 0],   # ur5e default, overridden per joint if specified
    "size3_limited": [0, 1, 0],
    "size1":         [0, 1, 0],
    "driver":        [1, 0, 0],
    "follower":      [1, 0, 0],
    "spring_link":   [1, 0, 0],
    "coupler":       [1, 0, 0],
}

joints = []
for j in root2.iter("joint"):
    name = j.get("name")
    cls  = j.get("class", "")
    axis_str = j.get("axis")
    if axis_str:
        axis = [float(x) for x in axis_str.split()]
    else:
        axis = joint_class_axis.get(cls, [0, 1, 0])
    ctrlrange = joint_class_ctrlrange.get(cls, [-6.2831, 6.2831])
